### Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory containing cutandrun output (01_prealign/, 02_alignment/, 03_peak_calling/, 04_reporting/, pipeline_info/) plus the reprocessed multiqc/multiqc_data/multiqc.parquet. |

### Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`deeptools/correlation_matrix.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/deeptools/correlation_matrix.py) | deepTools plotCorrelation matrix as a square table, one row per sample. | `sample` |
| [`deeptools/fingerprint_metrics.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/deeptools/fingerprint_metrics.py) | Per-sample deepTools fingerprint metrics, one row per library. | `sample`, `auc`, `synthetic_auc`, `auc_ratio`, `x_intercept`, `synthetic_x_intercept`, `elbow_point`, `synthetic_elbow_point`, `synthetic_js_distance` |
| [`deeptools/sample_pca.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/deeptools/sample_pca.py) | deepTools plotPCA coordinates in long form, one row per sample. | `sample`, `pc1`, `pc2`, `pc3`, `pc1_variance`, `pc2_variance` |
| [`macs2/peaks.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/macs2/peaks.py) | Concatenate MACS2 narrowPeak calls into one tidy peak table. | `sample`, `peak_id`, `chr`, `start`, `end`, `width`, `summit`, `score`, `fold_enrichment`, `neg_log10_pvalue`, `neg_log10_qvalue` |
| [`nf-core/cutandrun/caller_agreement.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/cutandrun/recipes/caller_agreement.py) | Do MACS2 and SEACR agree, sample by sample? | `sample`, `target`, `caller`, `n_peaks`, `total_bp`, `median_width`, `max_width`, `n_shared`, `n_unique`, `frac_shared`, `log10_n_peaks`, `other_caller`, `n_peaks_other` |
| [`nf-core/cutandrun/samples.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/cutandrun/recipes/samples.py) | One row per CUT&RUN sample, from the samplesheet the pipeline validated. | `sample_id`, `target`, `replicate`, `role`, `is_control`, `control_target`, `n_libraries`, `library_ids`, `single_end` |
| [`seacr/consensus_peaks.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/seacr/consensus_peaks.py) | Consensus peak x replicate presence matrix from CUT&RUN consensus BEDs. | `peak_id`, `target`, `caller`, `chr`, `start`, `end`, `width`, `num_peaks`, `num_samples`, `support`, `total_signal`, `max_signal` |
| [`seacr/fragment_lengths.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/seacr/fragment_lengths.py) | Fragment-length distribution per sample, the signature CUT&RUN QC figure. | `sample`, `target`, `fragment_length`, `count`, `fraction`, `cumulative_fraction` |
| [`seacr/peak_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/seacr/peak_summary.py) | One row per sample: what SEACR called and how strong those calls are. | `sample`, `threshold_mode`, `num_peaks`, `total_bp`, `width_median`, `width_mean`, `width_max`, `total_signal_sum`, `total_signal_median`, `max_signal_median`, `signal_density_median` |
| [`seacr/peaks.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/seacr/peaks.py) | Tidy every SEACR peak of every sample into one table. | `sample`, `peak_id`, `threshold_mode`, `chr`, `start`, `end`, `width`, `summit`, `total_signal`, `max_signal`, `signal_density`, `log10_total_signal` |
